messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy request for SHA da39a3 to prod-eu scheduled now. Hotfix (service: router) — rollback window 30m. Requires approvals: eng-release, oncall. Canary in eu-west1 for 5m. Links: https://deploys.internal/r/da39a3

sara: hitting an 8xx spike in prod-eu, need this out now. Suggest bypassing full canary and doing a staggered rollout (eu-west1 -> eu-west2 -> full eu). @matt you're oncall — can you weigh in? :rotating_light:

matt: looking. any DB migrations or config changes bundled?

leo: no schema changes, pure binary. Fix is a rate-limiter off-by-one that causes bursts of 502 under specific traffic patterns. Risk seems limited but user-facing.

nisha: prefer to keep a short canary, but ok with staggered if we attach a circuit-breaker. Proposal: CB at error_rate>=2% over 120s or p95>600ms. Who's comfortable bypassing the usual 5m canary? React +1 to approve.

dev-bot: Canary quick snapshot (first 90s): errors 0.9% -> baseline 0.4%. p95 latency 250ms -> baseline 230ms. Sample logs:
```
service=router level=warn msg="rate-limit retry" count=12
```

sara: error is user-facing (checkout failures). Bypassing will restore ~50% of traffic faster. I'll own rollback if anything goes sideways.

matt: +1 — approve staggered bypass with the CB in place. I'll monitor alerts and take rollback action if CB trips.

leo: +1. Add a traffic-exclude rule for any problematic IP ranges if we see a localized regression.

nisha: +0 (conditional) — approve only if deploy-bot can apply CB automatically. If not, we do manual abort on CB trigger.

deploy-bot: Approval recorded: matt, leo, nisha (conditional). Proceeding with staged rollout: 10% eu-west1 -> 30% eu-west1 -> 60% eu-west2 -> 100% prod-eu. Circuit-breaker thresholds set: error_rate>=2% for 120s OR p95>600ms for 120s.

dev-bot: kicking off rollout... step1 -> 10% eu-west1. Monitoring: https://monitoring/internal/routers?deploy=da39a3

sara: observing step1 (10%): errors down to 0.2% after ~45s. :tada:

matt: good to see. proceed to 30% in eu-west1, i'll hold pager.

deploy-bot: step2 -> 30% eu-west1 completed. No automated CB triggers.

nisha: spotted a tiny spike localized to ip-range 35.22.* — looks like a client subset behaving differently.

leo: temporary traffic-rule created to exclude 35.22.* from the new rollout.

dev-bot: traffic-rule applied successfully. continuing -> 60% eu-west2.

sara: 60% rollout stable across both regions. proceeding to 100%.

deploy-bot: rollout complete. Post-deploy notes: release_notes: "hotfix: fix rate-limiter off-by-one causing 5xx for long-tail clients". Closing thread. Thanks everyone — :shipit:
